an3.128:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
an3.128:1.2: athakho bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya bārāṇasiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
an3.128:1.3: addasā kho bhagavā goyogamilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ rittassādaṃ bāhirassādaṃ muṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākatindriyaṃ
an3.128:2.1: mā kho tvaṃ bhikkhu attānaṃ kaṭuviyamakāsi
an3.128:2.2: taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvāssavissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
an3.128:2.3: athakho so bhikkhu bhagavatā iminā ovādena ovadito saṃvegamāpādīti.
an3.128:2.4: athakho bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto bhikkhū āmantesi
an3.128:3.1: idhāhaṃ bhikkhave pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya bārāṇasiṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ
an3.128:3.2: addasiṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave goyogamilakkhasmiṃ piṇḍāya caramāno aññataraṃ bhikkhuṃ rittassādaṃ bāhirassādaṃ muṭṭhassatiṃ asampajānaṃ asamāhitaṃ vibbhantacittaṃ pākatindriyaṃ
an3.128:4.1: mā kho tvaṃ bhikkhu attānaṃ kaṭuviyamakāsi
an3.128:4.2: taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvāssavissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti
an3.128:4.3: athakho so bhikkhave bhikkhu mayā iminā ovādena ovadito saṃvegamāpādīti.
an3.128:4.4: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an3.128:5.4: taṃ vata bhikkhu kaṭuviyakataṃ attānaṃ āmagandhe avassutaṃ makkhikā nānupatissanti nānvāssavissantīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjatīti.
